_comment: The milestone's own end-to-end proof of the Social Pillar v1 (route adapted to the shipped 4-NPC pool subset -- Krshia/Selys/gate_guard/Pisces -- and the canon [Diplomat] kit). ISSUE #123 REDESIGN: this is once again the LIVE [Diplomat] EARN canonical -- the fixture (social_loop_start) no longer pre-holds the class its own script banks the gained_by counters for (the story-impossible shape #119's fixture-coherence validator flagged and #122 grandfathered). PHASE A proves the rotating talk pools + the per-waking first-use seam: gate_guard/Selys/Krshia each play ONE pool DIALOGUE_LINE on their FIRST talk this waking and bank chatted_with_<id> + heard_gossip (climbing to [Diplomat]'s volume gate of 3); a SECOND talk to Krshia the same waking opens her real crate graph with NO second pool line (chatted_with_krshia never reaches 2 -- assert absent), and its hub starts missing_crate + banks asked_about_crate. PHASE B is the classless persuade earn: the Watch Sergeant's crate persuade is [Charming Smile]-gated (issue #50's ratified persuade-fork rule -- it CANNOT be the earn-persuade, it requires the class it grants), so the walk home first wins the (fixture-active) floodplains ambush (Warrior + Relc ally, met_relc from the fixture), then detours to goblin_encounter_2 and takes goblin_parley's Warrior-gated 'Stand aside' intimidate -- the organic persuaded_someone producer any classless-diplomat PC can reach (riverfarm_talk_start's own precedent comment names this exact path) -- banking persuaded_someone + goblins_spared + street_cleared and removing the warband without a fight. Both [Diplomat] gates (persuaded_someone>=1, heard_gossip>=3) are then banked while classes is still {warrior:1} (pinned immediately before the sleep: the class does NOT exist until the pillow). The inn sleep resolves class_gained{diplomat} LIVE (grants land at sleep, never at counter-bank) plus the same-beat Warrior 1->3 level-up the ambush earned; rogue is NOT gained this run's sleep anymore (recovered_crate_watch is banked post-sleep now). PHASE C proves the kit reaches the player: the field hotbar starts at 1 slot ([Basic Cleaning]) and grows live to 2 at the sleep beat ([Charming Smile], field-tagged; [Calming Touch] is not) -- the real 1->2 growth proof this canonical originally existed for -- then pressing Charming Smile's slot on Erin fires [Charming Smile] -> her friendly_line toast + befriended_moments + the journal (used_skills) reveal. PHASE D closes the issue #50 loop AFTER the earn: the Watch Sergeant's [Charming Smile]-gated free branch, locked to this PC an hour ago, now fires live (quest beat 1 + crate_scavengers removed + persuaded_someone -> 2). Fixture rng_state governs post-load (overrides --seed); seed 9 for convention.
